description: This file defines an abstract class for handling device authentication within an Eclipse Hono service, providing mechanisms to authenticate devices using a Vert.x auth provider, with context-sensitive provider retrieval.

classes.name: ExecutionContextAuthHandler
classes.description: An abstract class that provides authentication handling logic for devices, utilizing a Vert.x AuthProvider and execution context, designed to be subclassed for specific implementations.

methods.name: ExecutionContextAuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the auth handler with a given Vert.x AuthProvider.

methods.name: authenticateDevice
methods.description: Performs device authentication by parsing credentials, authenticating via the auth provider, and handling the result.

methods.name: getAuthProvider (private)
methods.description: Retrieves the AuthProvider from the context if available, otherwise defaults to the configured provider.
